name: Middle-Levels Graphs Are Strictly 2-Arc-Transitive
scope: Finite simple connected graphs under the survey conventions.
statement: Every middle-levels graph is 2-arc-transitive, and the containment is strict.
proof: The 2-arc-transitive classification contains the middle-levels family. The cube $Q_3$ is 2-arc-transitive but is not a middle-levels graph.
